norway4.description: Current in-repo Norway real-ocean ML baseline using four tracked public/demo slices.

world_wave1_candidates.description: First global candidate wave for post-Norway expansion. These manifests are optional until raw public products are prepared locally.

mid_atlantic_ridge.selection_reason: High expected bathymetric and gravity distinctiveness with strong offshore routeability.

iceland_greenland_margin.selection_reason: High-latitude offshore margin with distinct gravity structure and mission-relevant sea states.

mariana_approach.selection_reason: Deep-ocean trench approach with extreme terrain signature diversity.

bay_of_biscay.selection_reason: Retained as a backup candidate with broad public-data availability.

labrador_sea_margin.selection_reason: Retained as a backup candidate for North Atlantic margin diversity.

world_wave1.description: Initial curated non-Norway wave selected from the candidate list.

all_wave1.description: Norway baseline plus the first curated global wave.

dev.description: Fast local validation preset for region-set comparisons and coarse sweeps.

full.description: Heavier local sweep preset for shortlisted configurations.
